# `aitbc agent create`

Create a new agent and register it in the local agent directory.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent create [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Agent name. |
| `--type` | choice | `provider` | no | Agent type |
| `--compute-type` | text | `inference` | no | Compute type (inference, training, processing) |
| `--gpu-memory` | integer | — | no | GPU memory in GB |
| `--models` | text | — | no | Comma-separated list of supported models |
| `--performance` | float | `0.8` | no | Performance score (0.0-1.0) |
| `--max-jobs` | integer | `1` | no | Maximum concurrent jobs |
| `--specialization` | text | — | no | Agent specialization |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator URL (default: config agent_coordinator_url) |
| `--auto-detect` | flag | `false` | no | Auto-detect capabilities |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent create --name <name>
```
